headline: Silver Rises 4.01 Percent to $41.66 as Precious Metals Draw the Bid
narrative: Silver rose 4.01 percent to $41.66, money moving into the precious-metals pipe, the haven channel. Gold rose 1.58 percent to $3,591.5 on that same pipe. Oil rose 1.36 percent to $84.82, and the energy pipe took a bid beside the metals.
author: jordan
